name: ilm-red-addons-contrib
description: Hand-written add-ons for ilm.red, reviewed here before they are imported into the app.

scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.harness: vitest run --config gazette-voice/harness/harness.vitest.mjs --root . && tailwindcss -c gazette-voice/harness/tailwind.config.cjs -i gazette-voice/harness/tokens.css -o gazette-voice/harness/out/harness.css --minify && (python3 gazette-voice/harness/shoot.py || echo 'harness: no Chrome, pages only')
